title: Quality-filtered hotspots, 2015–2024
description: All 3,402 MODIS hotspots kept after the confidence and DBSCAN filters, with sub-district, peat depth class and distance to the nearest canal attached by spatial join.

title: Sub-district × month panel (1,320 rows)
description: The analysis panel: 11 sub-districts × 120 months with ONI, DMI, CHIRPS rainfall, ERA5-Land temperature, SPI-3, SPEI-3, hotspot counts, fire occurrence and static covariates.

title: Annual ONI, DMI and hotspot totals
description: June–November mean ONI and DMI against the yearly filtered hotspot count.

title: Seasonal profile of hotspots
description: Monthly share of all hotspots, median yearly share, how often the month had fire, and whether it counts as a fire month (Feb, Mar, Apr, Jul, Aug).

title: Sub-district summary
description: Correlations of monthly hotspots with ONI, rainfall and drought; peat area, land cover, population, vulnerability index and operational alert level for each of the 11 sub-districts.

title: Operational early-warning table
description: Alert level, ONI lag, thresholds, conditional fire probabilities and recommended actions per sub-district. Text columns are in Indonesian, as in the source analysis.

title: Hotspots by peat depth class
description: Share of hotspots against share of peat area in each depth class; ratio > 1 means over-represented.

title: Hotspots by distance to nearest canal
description: Hotspot share against peat-area share in five distance bands.

title: Distance to canal by peat depth (burnable land)
description: Median hotspot distance against random burnable-peat points, with Mann–Whitney tests and Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment.

title: Canal-distance logistic regression
description: Odds ratios for hotspot vs. random burnable-peat point; log_d is log10 distance to the nearest canal, depth classes are relative to class 1.

title: Land cover of hotspots within canal-proximate peat
description: Land-cover composition under hotspots against random points.

title: Early-warning skill: ONI + drought rule vs seasonal calendar
description: POD, FAR, POFD, CSI and Peirce skill score for the nested rule and the calendar baseline.

title: Hotspot counts under alternative filters, by year
description: How the annual hotspot count changes with the confidence cut-off and the DBSCAN filter.

title: Hotspots and peat depth by sub-district
description: Hotspot totals, share on peat, mean depth class where fires occurred, and area-weighted mean depth class of the sub-district's peat.

title: Oil palm fraction by peat depth class
description: Mean and median oil palm fraction (Descals et al. 2024 map) across the 208 peat polygons, by depth class.

title: ENSO response by sub-district
description: Share of fire months in El Niño vs other phases (Fisher test) and Poisson incidence rate ratio per +1 °C ONI, per sub-district, with Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted p-values.
